title: Attendance ledger, vol. III — p. 40
summary: The document Theo has been describing. Two pages so the interface has to page, and so that the reader sees a NORMAL column before the odd one — the anomaly is only legible against the pattern. Grants nothing: the player already holds attendance_sheet_anomaly by the time they can open it, and a document that re-grants what a scene gave is a document that made the scene redundant.
